Merge strategies for link_encounters()

Source: R/utils-link-encounters.R
merge_strategies.Rd

Internal helpers that reconcile one field across the rows of a multi-row care episode when link_encounters() collapses it to a single row.

Usage

merge_strategies

check_merge_fields(merge_fields, call = rlang::caller_env())

merge_field_value(values, patient_classes, primary_value, strategy, delimiter)

merge_concat(values, primary_value)

contains_whole(text, value)

merge_union_delimited(values, delimiter)

merge_union_ccdd(values, delimiter)

merge_prefer_yes(values, primary_value)

merge_prefer_admission(values, patient_classes, primary_value)

Format

merge_strategies is a character vector of the valid strategy names.

Arguments

merge_fields

A named character vector mapping column names to strategy names.

call

The environment errors are attributed to; see resolve_col().

values

The field's values across the episode's rows.

patient_classes

The episode's patient classes, one per row.

primary_value

The value on the episode's primary row (see pick_primary_row_index()), used as the fallback.

strategy

A single strategy name from merge_strategies.

delimiter

The delimiter separating individual values within a field.

text, value

Single strings: the text to search and the value to look for in it.

Value

merge_strategies is a character vector. check_merge_fields() returns merge_fields invisibly, or aborts. The merge_*() functions and merge_field_value() return a single merged value. contains_whole() returns a single logical.

Details

merge_strategies is the set of strategy names accepted by merge_fields. It is validated up front by check_merge_fields() and listed again by merge_field_value()'s fallback error, so the two can never drift apart. merge_field_value() dispatches one field's values to the strategy named in merge_fields.

The strategies are:

concat

Free-text merge: starting from primary_value, appends each other non-empty value unless the accumulated result already contains it as whole words or whole codes (contains_whole()). Text or a code that appears in one record but not the other is therefore kept, so extra detail or context is preserved: "fall" is not found in "waterfall", the diagnosis code "R10.9" is not found in "R10.90", and a SNOMED code is matched only as the whole number. Matching ignores case, punctuation, and spacing.

union_delimited

Splits each value on delimiter, trims whitespace, and returns the union of unique parts (in order of first appearance) rejoined with the same delimiter.

union_ccdd

For the ESSENCE CCDD/CCDDParsed structure "CC-values|DD-values": | separates CC from DD (fixed by the ESSENCE convention, not user-configurable) and delimiter separates values within each half. Unions unique values within each half separately, then rejoins.

prefer_yes

If any value is affirmative (case-insensitive "Yes", or 1/"1" for 0/1-coded flag columns), the merged value is that affirmative value; otherwise primary_value.

prefer_admission

The value from whichever row's patient_class indicates an admission (Inpatient, Direct Admit, or Admitted), if that row has a non-missing value; otherwise primary_value.

check_merge_fields() aborts, attributed to link_encounters(), unless merge_fields is a named character vector (possibly empty) whose values are all valid strategies.
